item.title: Chaffee SAR South rescues injured hiker in McCoy Gulch
item.description: Chaffee County Search and Rescue South rescued an injured hiker who fell down a waterfall near the west ridges of Tabeguache Peak Aug. 22.

item.title: Hospital hears positive finance update, construction progresses
item.description: The Salida Hospital District Board of Directors heard a positive update on the district’s finances and income for 2026 and an update on the ongoing construction work at its Salida facility, among other items, during its Aug. 25 meeting.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Pike, OMG Reporter

item.title: Trustees approve all, will take action on wildfire code next month
item.description: Without Mayor Ben Scanga or Mayor Pro-Tem Adrian Quintana, Poncha Springs trustees unanimously approved everything on the agenda Aug. 25 and verbally agreed to take action on the wildfire resiliency code at their next meeting.

item.title: Lucky Duckies enjoy some rain, event raises $22k
item.description: Salida Sunrise Rotary Club raised more than $22,000 in the annual Lucky Ducky Race Aug. 23 in Riverside Park, which will support local student scholarships as well as help local nonprofits.

item.title: Commissioners approve federal grant application to study Monarch Crest connector
item.description: Chaffee County commissioners gave their endorsement to a federal grant application to study a connector trail between Poncha Springs and recreation routes near Monarch Pass.
item.dc:creator: Max R. Smith, Times Reporter

item.title: Commissioners make formal comment to railroad regulator with eyes on a rails-to-trails project
item.description: Chaffee County commissioners are asking federal regulators to revive consideration of a regional trail along the Tennessee Pass railroad corridor as part of their review of a proposed Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern merger.

item.title: Once again, SHS boys’ soccer beats Alamosa 10-0
item.description: It’s déjà vu all over again as the Salida High School boys soccer team opened their season up with a 10-0 win over Alamosa Aug. 22, for the second straight year.

item.title: GOP candidate tour comes to Chaffee today
item.description: Chaffee County Republicans will host a countywide Meet-the-Candidates event at Chaffee County Fairgrounds Event Center in Poncha Springs from 11 a.m. to 8:30 p.m., with candidates on hand throughout the day.

item.title: Obituary: Debra Lynn (Aman) Kort
item.description: Debra Lynn (Aman) Kort was born on May 17, 1952, to Vervie May (Millard) Aman and Robert Dee Aman. She passed away Aug. 8, 2026 at the age of 74 years after a long battle with complications from throat cancer.
